extracted.intended_audience: CES exhibitors and their PR/communications teams (companies planning media outreach at CES)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical guidance for exhibitors on PR tactics and programs available at CES (ads, media briefings, B-roll, media lists, creator matching, and paid distribution) to maximize media coverage before and during the show.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use CES PR programs to generate buzz
rubrics_metrics.description: Generate buzz with media kits, press events, broadcast opportunities, and more. Through these programs exhibitors can position their innovations for increased media coverage and get on more attendees’ must-see lists!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage the variety of CES-offered programs (media kits, press events, broadcast opportunities) to increase visibility and drive media and attendee interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertise in the Official CES Daily
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduce your new product to thousands of CES attendees with an ad in the Official CES Daily.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact the listed advertising representative for rates and information if you want editorial/advertising presence in the CES Daily (contact provided). Ads reach large attendee audiences and can supplement editorial outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide an exhibitor B-roll media package
rubrics_metrics.description: A B-roll media package gives media an engaging and visual look at your product announcement. Exhibitors can submit B-roll for media to download and include in their CES coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare downloadable, high-quality B-roll that highlights product visuals and demonstrations to increase the chance of broadcast and online coverage. (Service noted as coming December 2026.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Host a media briefing in a CES-provided room
rubrics_metrics.description: For a flat fee, exhibitors can sign up to host a media briefing in a CES-provided room (LVCC or Venetian) during the show, which will be listed on the official CES 2027 Schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rooms are fully equipped with A/V resources and may be reserved for specified dates (e.g., Jan. 6-7). Openings are limited and bookings are processed on a rolling basis — plan and book early.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote booth events via CES platforms
rubrics_metrics.description: Exhibitors can list press briefings, demos, and other events hosted at their booth on CES.tech and the CES 2027 mobile app.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit booth event details through the Exhibitor Dashboard under 'Exhibitor Scheduled Events' so media and attendees can find your on-site programming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use content-creator matching opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: CES offers exhibitors the opportunity to connect with content creators in the tech industry looking for brands focused on content partnerships at CES and beyond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fill out the provided inquiry form; CES will reach out if they find a match. Use this to pursue influencer/content partnerships beyond traditional media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participate in CES Unveiled to break news early
rubrics_metrics.description: CES Unveiled Las Vegas is the official media event where innovative startups and global brands showcase what’s next, build momentum ahead of the show, and capture attention two full days before CES opens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this event for early access to top media influencers and to position major announcements before the main show floor opens.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the CES Media List (opt-in contacts)
rubrics_metrics.description: The CES media list includes contact information for all media that opted in to receiving targeted exhibitor news about new products and announcements happening during CES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access details via the Exhibitor Dashboard (available as of a listed date). The list is opt-in only; use it for targeted outreach rather than mass blasting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand and target journalist interests
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand what topics and information interest a journalist before reaching out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research each journalist's coverage areas and tailor your pitch. Use the product category filter on the media list to reach media that cover your product(s). Keep messages short and focused on what matters to that reporter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customize outreach and keep messaging concise
rubrics_metrics.description: Customize and personalize emails, while keeping the messaging short and concise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personalized, concise outreach is more likely to get engagement. Include only essential information and clear hooks relevant to the recipient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid mass blasting and repetitive messaging
rubrics_metrics.description: DO NOT: Send the same messaging to the same journalist multiple times. DO NOT: Blast the entire list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Blasting the entire list or repeating identical messages increases opt-outs and reduces long-term media receptivity. Prioritize quality and relevance over quantity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider paid distribution (PR Newswire) for amplification
rubrics_metrics.description: PR Newswire: The Official Wire Service of CES 2026 — amplify your news across a network of up to 4,000+ websites, 3,000+ media outlets, and a global media community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services include press release and multimedia distribution, complimentary visibility reports, guaranteed paid placement on premium technology websites, custom multichannel campaigns, and access to strategic counseling. Press releases distributed via PR Newswire are automatically posted to the official CES Exhibitor Media Center to maximize visibility.
